<details><summary>Original implementation and validation history (preserved)</summary>

A README plus diagram can now use an explicitly requested documentation express landing without claiming to be a critical hotfix or naming a runtime behavior suite. `--docs-only` selects the existing registered PDDA repository-docs suite; the driver, canonical skill, SOP and skill index agree on that rule.

The mode accepts ordinary README/docs/project text and image assets, keeps file/text bounds and the existing landing/receipt/resume flow, and rejects practical mixed code, policy-root, executable, symlink and code-to-text rename inputs. Image bytes do not count as text insertions. Content, link and rendering checks remain agent obligations; a filename or passing PDDA check does not establish semantic accuracy. The pending README diagram is not included.

Validation: existing express regression suite (113 checks), existing Codex-turn prerequisite (43 checks), and 16 recorded manual admission/negative controls in a separate full clone. Independent native Codex QA approved Round 2 with mechanical attestation after correcting paperwork eligibility. No new test suite, registry entry, gate runner, dependency or receipt schema.

Normal full publication gate: 409/409 green in 929 seconds at 824c9288; clone identity unchanged. The log, clone identity bracket and provenance are retained under `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-10-15+GH-1080/`; subsequent receipt-only publication uses the normal docs gate. Direct-landing admission is Costly: revert driver/skill/SOP together to restore the prior rule; existing receipts stay compatible.

Closes #1080
